profile_text.body:
Equifax describes itself as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools offering daily monitoring and alerts. Its site markets Equifax Complete, a monitoring product, and says that customers who become victims of identity theft are assigned dedicated ID Restoration Specialists who work on their behalf toward recovery. Much of the site is educational, covering how financial behavior affects credit, what appears on credit reports, fraud and identity theft warning signs, debt management, credit cards, loans, and personal finance, with a Spanish-language section on Equifax credit reports, credit scores, and money management.

The company is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker EFX, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with CIK 0000033185. The material harvested from its site does not describe AI products, and no MCP servers are listed for it.

Its recorded litigation exposure is in Georgia, with 105 cases. No individual cases are listed.
